visual_review.primary_identity_bridge: The official RIST profile lists 株式会社ハイレゾ香川 under its tenant introduction. The DBJ interview expressly identifies RIST Kagawa as the reused Takamatsu facility that began operations in December 2024 and distinguishes Ayagawa former-school development. This identifies the parent facility without relying on a generic foundation contact address.
visual_review.official_schematic_match: The foundation access schematic places RIST in the northwest portion of the foundation group, south of Sunmesse Kagawa across an east-west road. FROM Kagawa and Next Kagawa are separate southern blocks; the Kagawa Industry Brain Center administration building is to the east. The schematic establishes relative identity, not numeric coordinates or parcel boundaries.
visual_review.georeferenced_image_match: The context image shows the large convention/exhibition building and its parking north of the east-west road. Immediately south is the foundation complex: the selected northwestern building has a large rectangular western hall connected to a narrower eastern section with a conspicuous oval/circular roof feature. The neighboring curved administration building is east, and two distinct blocks lie south. This configuration agrees with the official access schematic and separates RIST from the adjacent institutions.
visual_review.photographic_correspondence: The facility-manager photograph shows a long pale facade with blue glazing and a projecting circular upper structure. The operator Takamatsu photograph shows the same family of long glazed facade, circular upper feature and tall pale hall with blue upper glazing and a large lower door. DBJ independently labels a photograph of that hall as the Takamatsu RIST facility. These combined morphology and setting checks support the parent-facility match; the photographs are not used to locate a particular internal data hall.
visual_review.pixel_selection_review: Pixel [690,610] is within the matched northwestern RIST roof complex, west of its oval/circular roof feature and north of the separate FROM/Next blocks. It is neither the east administration building nor the Sunmesse venue north of the road.
